span.p:
notification_fallback: when an in-process
tick run completes but the model missed a
recipient, deliverRequiredNotifications
writes the deterministic chase or escalation
rows and audits notification_fallback.
A queued tick that under-delivers fails
the job and retries on this ladder.
An escalation delivery retry can run after
the visit already became escalated.
Notification completion is not email delivery.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A party chase can enqueue a separate guest email
only with verified consent and live invitation access.
Real prearrival source checks suppress obsolete work.
Demo homes never send guest email.
Provider acceptance, failure and unknown outcome
are shown separately from the guest's reply.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Explicit cancellation retires open work and access.
Confirm and reschedule extend finite bearer access
through checkout plus 7 days without undoing revocation.
Semantic demo controls select the next eligible
persisted job; no job means no invented activity.
